name: Founders Circle
description: Holds the founding vision and final say while the village grows into governing itself. Can open and decide proposals, consent to quests, moderate the forum, declare how the village and its circles hold power, seat people in the village's roles, and decide changes to the org chart.

name: Steward Circle
description: Village Stewards coordinating the land and the work. Can consent to quests, post announcements to the whole village, log the land's own measurements, and put gatherings on the calendar.

name: Treasury
description: Keeps the money legible: tracks budgets and allocations, lists tokens and posts their prices, marks the cash the village owes as paid, and carries the cycle report to Hypha where the equity and voice tokens are governed.

name: Trained Practitioners
description: Members trained for work that needs it (machinery, earthworks, medicine). Some quests require this role.
